## Choose the process

| Process | Main source | Guide |
|---|---|---|
| Refresh CVD dashboards | Approved current event and mortality files | [Dashboard regeneration](dashboard-regeneration.qmd) |
| Refresh CVD tables | Approved current files and fixed monthly references | [Tabulation regeneration](tabulation-regeneration.qmd) |
| Rebuild Downloads | Approved catalogue records and ZIP packages | [Downloads page regeneration](downloads-page-regeneration.qmd) |
| Rebuild report listings | Published report landing-page metadata | [Report listings regeneration](report-listings-regeneration.qmd) |
| Rolling three-month update | Exact approved event and mortality release CSVs | [Rolling update](rolling-update.qmd) |
| Annual report and public health update | Approved releases plus year-specific analyst material | [Annual report](annual-report.qmd) |
| One-off report | Finished bespoke PDF and its private analytical evidence | [One-off report](one-off-report.qmd) |

The first four are Quarto presentation or indexing processes. They do not have a separate Stata analytical workflow. The three report routes create public content: the rolling builder is a narrow one-step route using already-approved sources, while annual and one-off products separate candidate creation, approval and publication.

All website work ends with a complete local render, review of Git changes and the normal branch-to-`main` deployment pathway. See [Render and publish the website](../../website/render-publish.qmd).
